review_scope: Finite constructor/flag and runtime-consumer comparison of all source relic/event CardCreationOptions creation paths, plus ordinary reward core paths and explicitly excluded custom modifiers. This is not live-game differential certification.
runtime_snapshot: 4004f77daf417adfe238639fe2b8e7f725e37316 (integrated stable simulator source snapshot; no installed-game differential certification).

constructor_facts.new_options: Both public overloads start Flags=0. The custom CardModel pool overload rejects nonempty single-rarity pools unless odds are Uniform; empty pools are permitted at construction but cannot draw a card.
constructor_facts.for_room: Monster/Elite/Boss => Source.Encounter with corresponding rarity odds. Shop => Source.Shop/Shop odds. Other valid rooms => Source.Other/RegularEncounter. Event room throws. No built-in flags.
constructor_facts.for_noncombat_default: Both CardPool and custom CardModel overloads use Source.Other/RegularEncounter and OR NoUpgradeRoll.
constructor_facts.for_noncombat_uniform: CardPool overload uses Source.Other/Uniform and OR NoUpgradeRoll.
constructor_facts.with_flags: Flags |= supplied flags. It never replaces or clears existing flags.
constructor_facts.card_reward_options_constructor: OR IsCardReward into the supplied mutable options for both initial generation and reroll.
constructor_facts.card_reward_manual_constructor: Initial options are empty-custom Other/requested source, Uniform, NoPool|NoModel|IsCardReward. RerollOptions are retained verbatim and are not ORed with IsCardReward.
constructor_facts.no_modify_hooks: CardFactory still dispatches ModifyCardRewardCreationOptions before selection. NoModifyHooks suppresses the final normal+late TryModifyCardRewardOptions batch only.
constructor_facts.no_card_model_modifications: Independent flag, not NoModifyHooks. No pinned source consumer checks this flag, so it does not suppress Egg, Wing, Crucible, Tress, Glitter or Fresnel late callbacks.
constructor_facts.no_rarity_modification: Does not suppress CardFactory built-in rarity RNG; interpreted by creation-option hooks such as custom modifier BigGameHunter.
constructor_facts.no_upgrade_roll: Suppresses built-in random upgrade RNG only. Does not imply NoHookUpgrades or disable late callbacks.
constructor_facts.upgrade_draw: When enabled, RollForUpgrade consumes its RNG draw before testing whether the chosen card is upgradable.
constructor_facts.source_other: Non-Uniform factories use base rarity odds and do not change encounter rarity offset unless ForceRarityOddsChange is set.
constructor_facts.core_rewards: RewardsSet ordinary Monster/Elite/Boss generation wraps ForRoom in CardReward. Tutorial manual rewards use the manual constructor and supplied ForRoom reroll options. Saved extra rewards reconstruct new options from saved pool/source/odds, then CardReward adds IsCardReward; game save wire-format parity is outside this review.

paths.actual_constructor: CardReward(manual3 cards, Other, rerollOptions); internal new(empty custom, Other, Uniform)

paths.actual_constructor: ForNonCombatWithDefaultOdds(empty custom CardModel[]) passed to manual CardReward

paths.actual_constructor: new(custom remaining Power pool, Other, original rarity odds); direct factory count1

Source rejects nonempty single-rarity custom pools with non-Uniform odds; simulator raises EngineError before RNG instead of silently changing odds. Ordinary mixed-rarity Power pools remain valid.
